move.text:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Hallo, thanks for the numbers and the offer of 14-day payment, which really helps us out. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. I hear you on the material costs and the delivery score, so I've sharpened my pencil and factored that in. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. We have free capacity for your parts. 

With the faster payment and 35 days lead time, I can come down to €32.00 per piece. So our offer is a price of €32.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. Our Lieferzeit is 35 days. With overtime we can deliver in 28 days, at a premium. 

We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH
